usage: The word '備份' is commonly used as a noun to refer to a backup copy of files or data.
'備份' can also imply the action of backing up, but it is mainly a noun in daily use.
It often appears in technology contexts, especially with computers and smartphones.
In sentences, '備份' can act as the object or subject when talking about data safety.
It is frequently used with verbs like '做' (do/make), '有' (have), or '冇' (not have) to describe backup status.
